# Desmos basics

Test fixture: a second general page. The built-in calculator is
[Desmos](https://www.desmos.com/calculator).

## Graph both sides {#graph-both-sides}

> **Desmos.** Enter each side of an equation as its own line; the
> x-coordinates of the intersections are the solutions.

> **Fails when:** the curves meet at a point that is off screen; zoom out
> before concluding there is no solution.
